description: This file contains the implementation of the AzureQueueDataManager class, which provides utility methods for managing Azure Storage Queues, including creating, deleting, clearing, peeking, retrieving, and deleting messages, as well as handling queue properties and connection policies.

classes.name: AzureQueueDefaultPolicies
classes.description: Contains default policies for Azure Queue operations such as retries and timeouts.

classes.name: AzureQueueDataManager
classes.description: Provides methods to interact with Azure Storage Queues, including queue initialization, message handling, and queue management.

methods.name: ConfigureOptions
methods.description: Creates and configures AzureQueueOptions with a connection string and optional message visibility timeout.

methods.name: GetQueueClient
methods.description: Returns a ValueTask wrapping the QueueClient, either from cache or by asynchronously creating a new one.

methods.name: InitQueueAsync
methods.description: Initializes the queue by creating it if it does not exist.

methods.name: DeleteQueue
methods.description: Deletes the queue if it exists.

methods.name: ClearQueue
methods.description: Clears all messages from the queue.

methods.name: AddQueueMessage
methods.description: Adds a message to the queue.

methods.name: PeekQueueMessage
methods.description: Peeks at the latest message in the queue without dequeuing it.

methods.name: GetQueueMessage
methods.description: Retrieves a single message from the queue.

methods.name: GetQueueMessages
methods.description: Retrieves multiple messages from the queue.

methods.name: DeleteQueueMessage
methods.description: Deletes a specific message from the queue.

methods.name: GetAndDeleteQueueMessage
methods.description: Retrieves a message and deletes it from the queue.

methods.name: GetApproximateMessageCount
methods.description: Returns an approximate count of messages in the queue.

methods.name: CheckAlertSlowAccess
methods.description: Logs a warning if an operation takes longer than the configured timeout.

methods.name: ReportErrorAndRethrow
methods.description: Logs an error and rethrows an exception as an AggregateException.

methods.name: GetCloudQueueClient
methods.description: Creates and returns a QueueClient based on the provided options.

methods.name: SanitizeQueueName
methods.description: Sanitizes a queue name to conform to Azure naming rules.

methods.name: ValidateQueueName
methods.description: Validates that a queue name conforms to Azure naming rules.
